agents.description: Síntesis de evidencia
completionEvidence: A claim-to-source mapping with identifiers and page, section, table or other available locations.
An account of contradictory findings, differences in methods and uncertainty.
Separation of supported findings, interpretation and proposed research.

agents.description: Referencias bibliográficas
completionEvidence: Verified identities and bibliographic fields with their provenance.
A mapping between in-text citations and bibliography entries.
Duplicate decisions, unresolved metadata and a record of authorized library changes.

agents.description: Diseño experimental
completionEvidence: The research question and authorized comparison or estimand.
Experimental units, allocation, measurements, analysis linkage and design assumptions.
Threats to validity, design limitations and scientific decisions still reserved to Roberto.

agents.description: Estudios con participantes
completionEvidence: Versioned instruments, participant procedures and the authorized analysis procedure.
Consent, access, retention and institutional conditions relevant to the assigned study.
A distinction between planned procedures, simulated exercises and observations from actual participants.

agents.description: Análisis estadístico
completionEvidence: Data provenance, inclusion and exclusion decisions, transformations and missingness treatment.
The specified analysis, assumptions, effect sizes and uncertainty with reproducible outputs.
A distinction between prespecified, exploratory and changed analyses, including resulting limitations.

agents.description: Reproducibilidad computacional
completionEvidence: Identified input versions, transformation steps, dependency versions, seeds where relevant and commands.
Executed outputs and comparison against the claimed or supplied result.
Unreproduced steps, numerical differences and environment limitations without invented success.

agents.description: Figuras científicas
completionEvidence: The data and transformations underlying each plotted element.
Editable figure sources, labels, units, uncertainty representations and output locations.
Visual verification performed and any renderer, resolution or accessibility limitations.

agents.description: Escritura científica
completionEvidence: A manuscript or revision grounded in the supplied evidence, with citation locations.
A record of unresolved claims, scientific decisions and missing evidence.
The checks actually run, including compilation or citation verification when applicable.

agents.description: Respuestas a revisores
completionEvidence: Every reviewer comment mapped to a response and decision.
Actual manuscript changes and verified locations for changes claimed in responses.
Requests requiring new analyses or evidence, disagreements and unresolved decisions.

agents.description: Revisión científica independiente
completionEvidence: Localized findings with source, argument or result evidence and their consequences.
Checks performed, materials inspected and limitations of the review.
A separation of confirmed defects, uncertainty and proposed improvements.

agents.description: Aprendizaje automático y aprendizaje profundo
completionEvidence: The question, learning objective, architecture or method and justified comparisons.
Dataset provenance, partitions, preprocessing boundaries and evaluation conditions.
Generalization findings, uncertainty and failure analysis with executed evidence distinguished from proposals.

agents.description: Modelos de lenguaje y sistemas con agentes
completionEvidence: The question and separately identified model, instructions, retrieval, tools and orchestration.
Versioned evaluation materials, contamination considerations and scoring procedure.
Observed errors, uncertainty, permitted tool actions and limits on inference.

agents.description: Visión por computadora y percepción multimodal
completionEvidence: Sensor or modality provenance, annotation conditions and partition boundaries.
Transformations, calibration, synchronization and applicable geometry assumptions.
Metrics and errors by relevant observed conditions with limits on generalization.

agents.description: Interacción entre personas y sistemas de inteligencia artificial
completionEvidence: Definitions of the human interaction concepts and a reasoned mapping to measures.
The system behavior, participant activity and interaction conditions under study.
Evidence and limitations concerning interpretation, control, reliance or recovery.

agents.description: Realidad extendida
completionEvidence: Experience, device, rendering and interaction conditions relevant to the question.
Definitions and measurements of the assigned spatial or immersive outcomes.
A separation of simulator, device and participant observations with relevant comfort and accessibility limits.

agents.description: Inteligencia artificial para sistemas físicos
completionEvidence: The physical task, environment assumptions, observations, actions and learning objective.
Model or policy evidence and simulation-to-reality differences.
Operating conditions, uncertainty and a separation of simulated results from physical execution.

agents.description: Modelado matemático y simulaciones
completionEvidence: Equations, units, assumptions, parameters and initial or boundary conditions.
Implementation, numerical verification, sensitivity and applicable convergence evidence.
Calibration provenance and empirical validation distinguished from agreement with a simulation.

agents.description: Matemáticas
completionEvidence: Precisely stated objects, domains, assumptions and proposition or derivation.
A justified argument, derivation or localized counterexample with dependencies.
A distinction between proof, symbolic checks, numerical examples and unresolved steps.

agents.description: Robótica
completionEvidence: Kinematic, dynamic, estimation, planning or control assumptions for the assigned system.
Frames, units, time, sensing, actuation constraints and reproducible experiment conditions.
Simulated and physical results identified separately, with execution authority and observed limitations.
